h: Umahi says the Lagos-Calabar highway could stall if Tinubu loses in 2027
p: Works Minister David Umahi has reportedly urged voters to back Tinubu, saying the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway may stay unfinished otherwise. He also said Peter Obi is no threat to the president.
more: The remarks drew mixed reactions online.
Opposition parties are yet to respond.
